# Tax Calculation Correctness & Security Checklist: Tax Engine (Phase 5)

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements quality of feature 006's two highest-risk clusters — the calculation semantics (determinism, ordering, compounding, rounding) and the security/data-integrity posture (isolation, authorization, audit, snapshot immutability) — before planning tasks.
**Created**: 2026-09-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Calculation Semantics & Determinism

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the compound-base model quantified — exactly which earlier taxes feed a rule's base, and is the resolution rule (earlier-in-order only) stated unambiguously? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012; research §2]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for a compound reference that points at a rule sorting later in the order or retired after save — is the behavior specified rather than implied? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-012, FR-008; research §2]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the rounding rule (half-up, per line, once, at end of line calculation) stated with enough precision that two independent implementations would produce identical amounts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013; clarification 4]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is determinism of the calculation verifiable from the requirements — is "identical input and configuration" defined (which inputs constitute identity)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements defined for ordering ties (two rules sharing sort_order) at both save time and calculation time, consistently? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008; research §5]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the empty-basket behavior specified for every scope combination, not just the no-rules case? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for extras' inclusion in the taxable base at category scope (not only item scope)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012; clarification 1]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the treatment of quantity (integer vs fractional, bounds) specified for the calculation input? [Gap, contracts §3]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the exactness requirement (no floating-point drift) extended to rates, not only amounts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, FR-013]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are requirements defined for the interaction of a branch-only rule with compound sources — can a branch-only rule compound on a restaurant-level rule, and is that stated? [Gap, research §6]

## Security, Isolation & Data Integrity

- [ ] CHK011 - Are authorization requirements stated for every new function across all roles (owner, branch manager own/other branch, cashier, kitchen, super admin, other restaurant) rather than by example? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002, FR-003]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the snapshot's self-contained design (no FK, embedded rule ids) specified so immutability cannot be violated through another table's lifecycle? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017; research §7]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the once-only snapshot guarantee defined declaratively (a partial unique constraint), not only procedurally? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016; research §3]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are requirements defined for who may READ snapshots, distinct from who may write them? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004; data-model policy matrix]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is cross-restaurant impossibility of scope targets and compound references required declaratively (composite FKs), not merely validated in the RPC? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006; data-model]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are audit requirements defined for every accepted change type, including reorder and no-op (nothing written), with branch scope where applicable? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the delete carve-out (unreferenced rule deletable; referenced rule never deletable) precisely bounded — what counts as "referenced"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010; research §7]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are requirements defined for concurrent configuration edits (two owners, owner+branch manager) at the data layer? [Coverage, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is it required that nothing introduced by this phase becomes publicly readable, including snapshot payloads? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, FR-019]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the branch-manager override scope (own branch only) required consistently across rate replacement, branch-only rules, and reorder? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, FR-008, FR-009; clarification 2]

## Notes

- Defaults used (no user preferences stated): Depth Standard, Audience Reviewer, Focus = the two top relevance clusters (calculation correctness/determinism; security & data integrity).
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
